The packaging for this product has changed. You may receive this item in either the previous packaging or new packaging. There is no change to the product formulation.

All-in-one universal, paintable hybrid sealant and adhesive. Suitable for many interior and exterior applications. Excellent adhesion without primer on most substrates without the need of additional fixings, even on damp surfaces. Bonds metals (including lead), laminated, single, insulation, burglar-proof and self-cleaning glass, wood and polystyrene. Highly flexible and does not shrink. Can be painted with water based and synthetic paints. Ideal for many uses such as sanitary, general purpose, construction, frame and glazing, gap filling, roof and guttering and grab adhesion.
